name: Marisa du'Paige
summary: In the caves outside the Deadmines, Marisa du'Paige fights beside Moonbrook's outlaws. Few of their laborers and highwaymen wield arcane magic in southwestern Westfall.

sections.title: Arcane Talent in the Tunnels
sections.body: Beneath Moonbrook, caves lead toward the Deadmines. Cutpurses, renegade miners, and thugs guard those tunnels. Among them is Marisa du'Paige, a skilled human mage. Many spellcasters train in Stormwind's Mage Quarter or serve the Kirin Tor, but Marisa has joined Westfall's outlaws and brigands in their underground passages.

faq.answer: Marisa du'Paige is a rare human mage in the outer caves leading into the Deadmines. While thieves and laborers patrol those passages, she wields arcane spells to defend the underground network.
Marisa du'Paige appears infrequently in the public cavern system beneath Moonbrook in Westfall. She can be found in the tunnels just outside the Deadmines instance portal threshold.

faq.q: Why is a human mage hiding in the Deadmines caves?
faq.answer: Some arcane practitioners leave Stormwind's high towers. Deserters, renegades, and sympathetic commoners have joined the outlaw cause across Westfall, bringing steel and sorcery to strongholds beneath Moonbrook.

angles.text: Marisa du'Paige shows that arcane training in the kingdom reaches beyond the Kirin Tor's towers and Stormwind's wizard sanctum. Rogue spellcasters sell their talents to criminal networks.
As an Alliance adventurer, stay alert for du'Paige in the tunnels beneath Moonbrook. A spellcaster among the cutpurses can quickly make a skirmish deadly.
